title.romaji: Chi ni Ueta Hanayome wa Ou o Kurau
title.english: The Bloodthirsty Bride Devours the King
title.native: 血に飢えた花嫁は王を喰らう
synonyms: The bloodthirsty bride devours the king

synopsis:
In a war-torn world, Kate, a princess-priestess, gains the power of the progenitor vampire to protect her kingdom. Fearing future threats, she proposes a contract marriage to Luka, the king of the continent’s greatest nation, offering her power in exchange. However, Luka despises vampires and treats her coldly. As their unwanted marriage begins, Kate’s vampire instincts awaken uncontrollably, binding them together in a dangerous relationship caught between duty, instinct, and the possibility of love.

(Source: MU)
